name: Birmingham City University

facts.text: BCU's City Centre Campus is made up of eight buildings including the Curzon Building, Millennium Point, the Parkside Building, the Benjamin Zephaniah Building, the Royal Birmingham Conservatoire and STEAMhouse.
facts.sourceTitle: City Centre Campus | Birmingham City University (search snippet; page not fetched)

facts.text: Birmingham New Street and Birmingham Moor Street stations are less than a mile from the City Centre Campus; the Curzon Building on Cardigan Street is at its heart.
facts.sourceTitle: City Centre Campus - Map and Directions | Birmingham City University (search snippet; page not fetched)

facts.text: City South Campus in Edgbaston is a short walk from Five Ways station (one stop from Birmingham New Street); the nearest Metro stop is Edgbaston Village, about half a mile away.
facts.sourceTitle: City South Campus - Map and Directions | Birmingham City University (search snippet; page not fetched)

facts.text: BCU describes itself as a large and diverse university set in the heart of Birmingham with a focus on practice-based learning, with two main campuses plus other sites across the city.
facts.sourceTitle: Locations and maps | Birmingham City University (search snippet; page not fetched)

facts.text: After an unconditional offer and payment of GBP 1,000 of the deposit, BCU emails an invite to the Enroly CAS Shield platform within three to five working days; any required interview is recorded on CAS Shield, self-booked, and must be completed within seven working days.
facts.sourceTitle: CAS Shield - a step-by-step guide for international offer holders | Birmingham City University

sources.title: Credibility interviews | Birmingham City University
topics: your reasons for studying in the UK
examine other countries/universities and explain differences between options
connect prior experience to your course
quotes: Why did you choose Birmingham City University (BCU)?
Where will you live in the UK?
Why did you choose your course?
How will the course be delivered and assessed?
How do your studies fit into your career plans?
If pursuing your course of study is higher in the UK than in your home country, why have you decided to incur the extra costs of studying in the UK?
You have previously studied in the UK - why have you chosen to return?
You have had a long break from your studies. Why are you returning to study now?
Do you plan to work in the UK?
How will you fund your studies?
sources.notes: Fetched. Framed as the Home Office (UKVI) credibility interview: 'The Home Office interviews a selection of Student visa applicants before granting them immigration permission to come to the UK.' 'Interviews are conducted in English and possibly via video link.' 'A Home Office staff member will ask you about your course, where you want to study and your reasons for studying in the UK.' 'Your application is likely to be refused if you are asked to attend an interview and do not do so without a reasonable explanation.' Video tips - don'ts: hold ID too far from camera, reflective backgrounds, sounding scripted, excessive hand gestures, lengthy answers. Ids q-11, q-08, q-100, q-68, q-04 come from the tips list (modules, compare countries/universities, five-year plan, prior experience).

sources.title: CAS Shield - a step-by-step guide for international offer holders | Birmingham City University
sources.notes: Fetched. 'If required, you will be invited to record an interview on CAS Shield, you can self-book this interview and it needs to be completed within seven working days.' Invite to Enroly CAS Shield is emailed within three to five working days after an unconditional offer and GBP 1,000 deposit. Page gives no question count, timing or pass/fail rules.

sources.title: Getting your CAS | Birmingham City University
sources.notes: Snippet: applicants complete a Pre-CAS Questionnaire via a unique link in CAS Shield; students from India, Pakistan, Bangladesh, Ghana, Sri Lanka, Iran, Nepal, Somalia, Sierra Leone or Nigeria are allocated a place in the automated pre-CAS interview process. A related page (accepting your offer) says students from India, Pakistan, Bangladesh, Nigeria and Nepal will be asked to take a pre-CAS interview and pay an initial deposit of up to GBP 1,000.
